description:
LockLock is a lightweight, privacy-first app locking solution designed to secure your apps without requiring root access or internet connectivity. Built with modern Material 3 design principles, LockLock offers a seamless, elegant user experience while providing strong protection for your personal data.
Features
•
App Locking Without Root LockLock uses Android Accessibility Services to detect and block unauthorized app launches, securing your apps with a customizable password or PIN.
•
Anti-Uninstall Protection By leveraging Device Administrator privileges, LockLock prevents unauthorized uninstall attempts, safeguarding your app locks from tampering.
•
Brute Force Protection To protect against password guessing, LockLock temporarily locks the app after repeated failed unlock attempts.
•
Forgot Password Support Securely recover access with a security question if you forget your password.
•
Material 3 UI Enjoy a clean, modern interface designed for intuitive navigation and ease of use.
•
Fully Offline Operation No internet permissions or connectivity required — your data stays private and local to your device.
Why Choose LockLock?
• No root required
• Privacy-focused, no data leaves your device
• Robust anti-tampering protections
• Clean, minimal Material 3 design
• Lightweight and resource-efficient
• Open source and community-driven
• Download and install LockLock via the F-Droid app (recommended for smooth permission setup).
• Launch the app and set your master password and security question.
• Grant Accessibility and Device Administrator permissions when prompted for full protection.
• Select which apps to lock.
• LockLock will immediately start protecting your selected apps with the configured password.
Permissions
• Accessibility Service: Required to monitor and block locked apps without root.
• Device Administrator: Required to prevent unauthorized uninstall and enhance security.
